protocol_selection.aggregation: arithmetic mean of nine inner macro-F1 scores, equal three loads and three seeds; not pooled probabilities
protocol_selection.detector_metrics: normal specificity, IR recall and OR recall averaged by MAT then equally by validation load
protocol_selection.detector_reference: new F14 detector with this same fit/calibration policy, not V1 test metrics
protocol_selection.performance_selector: detector-admissible masks; highest mean F1, then highest worst-load mean across seeds, then catalogue order
protocol_selection.numeric_tie_rule: within 1e-12 of stage maximum; mean, then worst-load mean, then catalogue; not a predictive margin
protocol_selection.cost_selector: same candidate fits and detector constraints; F1 within margin; choose measured total cost using empirical envelope rule
protocol_selection.cost_tie_rule: min upper_ms; overlapping candidates with lower_ms<=minimum_upper form tie set; prefer F1, worst-load F1, catalogue order
protocol_selection.fallback: F14 and record target not achieved if no eligible target-reaching candidate
protocol_selection.cost_reduction_vs_performance_selector: report measured difference; no guaranteed improvement
protocol_selection.missing_or_failed_inner_fit: stop; never omit from the mean

protocol_classical.selection: mean inner macro-F1; worst-load mean then grid order; outer refit after selection

protocol_DNN.training_loss: mean class-balanced weighted sparse crossentropy plus L2
protocol_DNN.validation_loss: unweighted mean sparse crossentropy plus L2
protocol_DNN.outer_epochs: integer median of nine best inner epochs for that mask; no outer early stopping
